source_refs.note: Exercise 13.3, Question 2: maximum of S(x) = 100 - 5x^2 and its rate of change (book p.257). Answer key (PDF 311) prints it as number 5.

blocks.prompt: 2. Structural stress on a bridge is modeled by the function \(S(x) = 100 - 5x^2\), where \(x\) is the distance from the center of the bridge. Find the point where the stress is maximum and calculate the rate of change of stress at that point.
blocks.explanation:
Yeh maximum (sab se zyada value) dhoondne ka sawal hai.
Humein teen cheezein chahiye: kis jagah stress sab se zyada hai, woh stress kitna hai, aur wahan stress ka rate of change.
Plan: \(S'(x)\) nikal kar zero ke barabar rakhna, maximum ki tasdeeq, phir values nikalna.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(S(x) = 100 - 5x^2\), \(x\) = bridge ke centre se faasla.
Humein find karna hai: maximum stress ka point, maximum stress, aur us point par rate of change.
Tareeqa: Smooth curve ki choti (sab se ooncha point) par tangent bilkul seedha (horizontal) hota hai, yani slope zero: \(S'(x) = 0\). Pahar ki choti ka socho: upar jaate hue raasta charhai wala, utarte hue dhalaan wala, aur bilkul choti par hamwaar. Phir dono taraf \(S'\) ka sign dekh kar pakka karenge ke yeh maximum hi hai.

Differentiate karein
\[S'(x) = -10x\]
Kyun: \(5x^2\) ka derivative \(10x\), aur aage minus hai; 100 constant hai to us ka derivative zero.

Derivative ko zero rakhein
\[-10x = 0 \Rightarrow x = 0\]
Kyun: Slope sirf \(x = 0\) par zero hota hai, to maximum (ya minimum) sirf yahin ho sakta hai.

Maximum ki tasdeeq
\[x < 0:\ S'(x) > 0\]
\[x > 0:\ S'(x) < 0\]
Kyun: \(x = 0\) se pehle slope positive (stress barh raha hai), baad mein negative (stress ghat raha hai). Barhna phir ghatna ka matlab choti, yani maximum. Ek aur saada daleel: \(-5x^2\) kabhi positive nahi hota, is liye \(S(x)\) kabhi 100 se zyada nahi ho sakta.
Dhyan dein: Sirf \(S' = 0\) se maximum saabit nahi hota; minimum par bhi slope zero hota hai. Sign check zaroor karein.

Maximum stress aur rate of change
\[S(0) = 100 - 0 = 100\]
\[S'(0) = -10(0) = 0\]
Kyun: \(x = 0\) ko \(S\) mein rakha to maximum stress 100 aaya, aur \(S'\) mein rakha to rate of change zero. Matlab bridge ke bilkul beech mein stress sab se zyada hai aur wahan lamhe bhar ke liye na barh raha hai na ghat raha hai.
blocks.final_answer: Maximum \(x = 0\) par (bridge ka centre); maximum stress \(= 100\); wahan rate of change \(= 0\)

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key ne Exercise 13.3 ke jawabat ko 1 se 8 ke bajaye 4, 5, 6, 8, 11, 12, 13, 14 number diye hain. Is sawal ka jawab number 5 par chhapa hai: Max. stress \(= 100\), Rate of change \(= 0\), jo sahi hai.
